scope: Shared material and typography candidates for reviewed Unlimited originals. No per-card renderer offsets or scan corrections. Component-specific source receipts, comparisons and all residuals remain explicit; this study schema is not a shipped runtime profile. The white ordinary frame retains its shared risk-aware compromise; dual pinline geometry and five-color palette have actual native evidence while preserving source edge ink. Heading/artist/PT real ink and shadows, land brown contrast/blackpoint and full-frame outline colors, footer/dual profile adapter integration, final current Original/Oracle faces, etching, visual normalization certification and whole-card scores remain required. Use corrected original Drain Life 1B in final integration; historical full-face receipts remain frozen.

whiteSelection.method: calibration mean minus one quarter of the worst calibration loss against current
whiteSelection.note: Exploratory shared compromise. It improves calibration and validation means while reducing the largest white regression from roughly 23 to 7 regional index points. It is not a per-scan fit or a new blind-validation result.

blackLevelSelection.objective: Calibration median printed-keyline Oklab distance plus positive mean frame/paper color regressions and 0.25 times positive texture-spread error regressions. Ties prefer the weaker variant.
blackLevelSelection.etchingScope: Empty layers unchanged; no nondefault etching certification.

basicLandSelection.scope: Geometry candidates only. Existing source bytes and original wording; shared values per land color, fixed scan poses. Basic-land colors, heading/body/artist fitting, ten dual lands and whole-set checks are still pending.

dualLandSelection.scope: One transform for ten duals. Eight calibration names select it; two reserved names are reused development validation. Source preparation uses the unchanged production material pipeline. Fixed opaque support excludes art and nearby text. Exact original printing inputs, independent scan poses, source/definition hashes, current native PNGs, face alpha and default etching layers are checked. A common one-pixel art underlap covers all ten source apertures; art placement changes and is not scored here. These regional indices do not certify colors, typography, full-card scores or complete the set.

basicLandColorSelection.scope: Shared brown-frame adjustment across fifteen original basic references; five paper adjustments. The third illustration of every basic has a darker scan palette. Retain those five measured regressions; do not fit their color individually. Colored rim accents have a separate native-verified candidate. Contrast/black levels and reuse on the ten dual composites remain open. No independent-name validation or complete-set certification.

units.size: font size delta in canonical pixels
units.width: percentage delta in horizontal scale; 2 means a factor of 1.02

bodyPolicyCandidate.integrationScope: These study options need a typed set-profile adapter. Retention based on dense regular originals must not undo safe Oracle insets or shrinking. Recheck against the final prepared frame/material pipeline before release.

powerToughnessProbe.review: The global position/size probe improves the regional mean but regresses 26 of 92 cases, up to 11.1 points. Zoom inspection shows stroke/ink contrast differences, including 1/x examples; resolve ink/stroke/shadow matching before accepting a universal positional refit. No per-card stats overrides are proposed.

basicLandAccentSelection.scope: One source-local outline adjustment per basic color, shared across its three illustrations. Fixed projected line strips measure color; shared source rings and hue weights apply it during cached material preparation. Group means improve for all five colors, but black median error rises and four individual printings regress. Preserve every residual, including the 3.83-unit white regression. No per-card palette or per-scan offset/color fit; no independent-name validation. Land contrast/black levels and dual composite/pinline colors still need checks.

manaPigmentCandidate.scope: Actual shared disc and common ink targets through the production material preparation path. Native baseline PNGs, poses, cost scores and pixel isolation are independently verified from the cache. Targets use calibration pigment quantiles rather than edge-score optimization. Validation median disc error falls 2.27 to 1.01 Oklab units; ink falls 26.88 to 3.11. The whole-cost structural index falls 70.56 to 69.62/100, confirming that color/edge objectives must remain separate. Global circle and internal glyph/numeral geometry still need their own fit. No runtime profile adopted.

manaComponentCandidate.scope: Shared source-relative mana palette, disc/pitch geometry, five colored glyph scales, numeral transforms and red-only ink expansion have actual native evidence on all 277 current original costs. Fixed frame-only scan poses are retained; no per-card placement defaults are proposed. Red expansion 0.4 requires opaque-percentile paper sampling. Existing X is retained after comparison with six cached fonts; Guardian Angel has one low-contrast X perimeter residual but remains in complete-cost replay. Physical-disc measurements succeed for all 277. Internal-ink indices sample the rightmost pip of each cost and improve 76.71 to 86.50/100, with 242 gains and 35 regressions; whole-cost structure moves 72.89 to 72.73/100, with all outliers retained. Only cost/rules pixels change, alpha is unchanged and no heading pixels change. Complete frame/body/footer integration, Oracle behavior, etching, visual normalization review and whole-card validation are still required. No runtime profile is adopted.

XSourceReview.residual: Guardian Angel pale disc has a search-boundary perimeter measurement. It remains in all-cost native replay; no per-card placement or scan registration is fitted.

dualLandPinlineCandidate.selection: Retain the dark source edge instead of using freely brown edge ink to compensate blur. The five shared colors improve every card mean and 32/40 side windows; eight side regressions remain. The free-edge alternative has slightly better mean distance but a larger worst side regression (0.88 vs 0.38 Oklab units). No per-card palette or renderer pose is fitted.
